City of Inglewood

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  September 28, 2020

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the 1st Floor, Finance Conference Room at
11:39 a.m.:

  Members Present:  Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Derald Brenneman, City Attorney’s Office
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk’s Office (Call-In)

  Staff Present:  Sabrina Barnes, Parks and Recreation Community Services
  Amber Haley, Fleet Maintenance

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of September 14, 2020, meeting was approved as recorded.

2. Stuart Art Services – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for design format of
  existing public art website in the amount of $100.00. Motion carried unanimously.

3. OP Electrical Services – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing services
  on replacing the electrical panel at Edward Vincent Park in the amount of $6,200.00. Motion
  carried unanimously.

4. Performance Tuck Repair, Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for body
  repair services for an emergency response vehicle in the Police Department in the amount of
  $5,821.03. Motion carried unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Maria Heaney reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned
at 11:49 a.m. Adjournment
